reading.text: At the tailor shop, an adult learner handles a real-world responsibility and must make a clear decision. First, the adult learner considers Scissors, Pin, Iron, and Fabric. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Next, the adult learner considers Elastic, Interfacing, Dress, and Suit. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Next, the adult learner considers Skirt, Trousers, Jacket, and Shirt. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. Finally, the adult learner considers Blouse and Vest. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the adult learner checks the details before moving on. By the end, the adult learner can explain the decision clearly and use the new words in a connected response.
